ablation.name: phase4h5c_eota_a07_freq_lowpass
ablation.notes: Phase 4H.5c: EOTA + alpha=0.7 + freq_lowpass_alpha=0.5 + haar_dwt. Triple combination: EOTA (terminal style injection) + per_subband (frequency-domain AdaIN) + freq_lowpass (frequency-aware token masking). Theoretically: 3 orthogonal style controls - WHEN (EOTA), WHERE (per_subband), WHAT (freq_lowpass).
